title: I Let the Movie Reserved-Seat Scanner Catch the Group Who Sat in Mine

parts.text: I scanned H12 at 7:08 p.m. and a group was already in H12–H15 with no stubs. The usher policy said: SCAN THE SEAT. MOVE THE UNSCANNED. I was twenty-four, date, holding a lit H12. Usher Pete shrugged. I photographed the lit seat, the empty scans, and the group. Pete called it a fill. Fill is a word groups use when a scan exists. I let the scanner ping until Pete moved them. H12 sat me. The theater finally looks like reserved, not a picnic. The rule looks ordinary now, which is the whole point. If it is written, it can be applied to the person who wrote it.

social.video_title: They sat in H12 with no scan — Part 1/1
social.description: Lit seat, empty scans, a moved group. Has a fill ever been your date's row?
